name: pdf2epub-skills
description: Convert text-based PDF books to clean, e-reader-ready EPUBs and translate EPUBs into other languages (local extraction + Gemini)

plugins.name: pdf2epub
plugins.description: Convert a text-based PDF book into a clean, e-reader-ready EPUB using local PyMuPDF4LLM extraction plus Gemini text cleanup, and translate an existing EPUB into another language while preserving its structure, markup, and reading order. Works with any source language — title, author, and language are auto-detected.
